correctness.rationale: Haar orthogonality expresses the fourth moment as the sum of autocorrelation squares, including 49 at zero. In the displayed gauge the three two-pair shifts have squared moduli |x+y|², |y+z|², |x+z|², with sum 3+|s|²; three other representatives have one term each. Listing the three four-pair shifts (1,0),(0,1),(1,1) gives the stated A+WB. Expanding each squared norm gives the sum of the unmixed terms |s|²+9+2 Re(s) and the mixed coefficient 2(s+e2)/(xy). Thus M=61+2(|s|²+L). Since e2=xyz times conjugate(s), for t=|s|≤1 the last parenthesis is at least 2t²+9-10t≥1, and for t≥1 it is at least t². Equality requires t=1, L=0, Re(s)=-1 and |s+e2|=2, hence s=e2=-1 and xyz=1. The cubic (X-1)(X+1)² then fixes the unordered roots as (1,-1,-1), and A+WB=0 fixes W in each placement, yielding all three and only the listed tuples after recovering T. For the upper endpoint the multiplicities give 175; alignment in the (1,1) shift forces W=conj(U)=conj(V)=conj(T), and (1,0) then forces W=1. The torus is connected. The unique gauge restricts to the q-phase group, giving exactly q³ lifts of each of those minima for even q and none for odd q. Each shift coordinate is in [-2,2], so five or more in each finite dimension guarantees distinct characters and the identical moment functional; the orbit statement keeps the explicitly stated coefficient action.
residual_risks: No conclusion for aliased grids or the best value when q is odd. The gauge classification uses the stated phase action, not a quotient by lattice reflections or a narrower action restricted to grid translations.

value.rationale: The fixed support is the elementary centered hexagonal aperture already singled out in lattice-array design. Its optimal possible autocorrelation energy for one unimodular array, all phases attaining it and the even-alphabet obstruction answer a natural different question from complementary-family cancellation. They give a precise benchmark when only one array or a finite phase alphabet is available, without implying optical performance guarantees.
residual_risks: The result does not optimize distinguishability or reconstruction in a physical imaging system.
